title: Kyiv bridges hit

brief: Russian strikes hit Kyiv bridges and power sites; officials report 8 dead nationwide.

evidence.supports: Three bridges hit, electricity facilities targeted and eight deaths nationwide, attributed.

title: Food aid funding gap

brief: WFP seeks $12bn-plus for a 2027 plan to assist 91 million people.

evidence.supports: WFP announces 91 million people target for next year, just over USD12 billion required.

evidence.supports: Original reporting published 20 November of ongoing disruption; no unverified violent-video claim.

brief: US judge approves up to $7.25bn Roundup cancer-claims settlement.
